claims.drop: Devin Singletary (29, RB, NYG — 5.2 wk3, 31 season; Sal has him RB50)
claims.why: THE bid. He has the New England job outright: Week 2 was Henderson 16 carries on 33 of 55 snaps (including a 39-yard TD) against Stevenson's 6 carries on 20 of 55, and Stevenson owns the most RB fumbles in the league since 2021 (18, PFF). Sal: 'he is taking the backfield over.' Schedule behind it: after Week 3 at Jacksonville, New England draws Buffalo, Las Vegas, Chicago and Miami in four of five — all softer run matchups. He replaces Woody Marks (6.8) at RB2 for 12.8 → roughly +6 a week, every week, in a league where you only have to beat the bottom score. Sizing: the largest bid anyone has landed in this league all season is $400 (pitsonvillejags); $451 beats it and still leaves $348 after the Flowers bid. Co-owned — alealvarez7 has to key the number in.
